parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
><warning>A large time range for a domain with a high volume of resolution logs may cause query timeouts or inaccurate results.></warning>

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
